gaph.reason.label: Reason
gaph.reason.hint: Required, at least 5 characters. Recorded in the audit log with your name.
gaph.rate_limited: Too many sensitive actions in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
gaph.password.title: Reset the password of :name
gaph.password.confirm: A temporary password will be generated for :name. All their sessions and API tokens are closed at once, and they must choose a new password at their next sign-in.
gaph.password.shown_body: Give this temporary password to :name through a secure channel. They will be asked to change it when they sign in.
gaph.password.once: It is shown only once and is not stored anywhere in clear.
gaph.password.done_banner: Password reset for :name. Their sessions and tokens were revoked.
gaph.mfa.title: Reset two-factor authentication of :name
gaph.mfa.confirm: The authenticator app and recovery codes of :name are removed. All their sessions and API tokens are closed, and they must enrol again at their next sign-in.
gaph.mfa.done_banner: Two-factor reset for :name. They must enrol again at their next sign-in.
gaph.hotel.deactivate_confirm: :name will be marked inactive. The hotel you are working in and the last active hotel cannot be deactivated.
